51536020.protein: V-type immunoglobulin domain-containing suppressor of T-cell activation
51536020.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to human VISTA assessed as dissociation constant by SPR assay

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - SPR Binding Assa: SPR binding assay was performed on a Biacore S200 (General Electric Company, USA). Tested compounds were dissolved in DMSO at 1 mM concentration and diluted by PBS-P+ buffer (5% DMSO). The hVISTA protein was diluted to 100 μg/mL with sodium acetate solution (pH = 5.5), and then the protein was conjugated to CM5 chip. Tested compounds at different concentrations were injected at a flow rate of 0.5 μL/s at 25 °C. The KD value was calculated using the Langmuir binding model.
original_paragraph.Figure 1C caption: Binding curves of 1 to VISTA protein.
original_paragraph.Table 1 caption: The data are displayed as averages of duplicate assays ± SD.
original_paragraph.Results and Discussion - Biochemical Eva: A surface plasmon resonance (SPR) assay was used to determine the binding affinity of candidates with human VISTA and 15 best hits were screened and are shown in Figure S1. Among that 1 (Figure 1A) showed excellent binding affinity to human VISTA with a KD value of 256 ± 59 nM (Figure 1C).
original_paragraph.Figure 1C: The x-axis is labeled 'Time(S)' with a range from -50 to 200. The y-axis is labeled 'Response(RU)' with a range from -10 to 30. The legend indicates five curves corresponding to concentrations: 0.156 μM, 0.3125 μM, 0.625 μM, 1.25 μM, and 2.5 μM.
original_paragraph.Table 1: Compound 1 has a KD value of 256 ± 59 nM.
